correctness.rationale: The exact passage factors and target factor follow from independent first-step recurrences. Strict monotonicity and endpoint limits of F_n prove a unique interior global optimizer, adding any patch raises it. Independent site-specific maximization gives cue benchmark. For A_j bounded below 1, uniform estimates on 1/(1-A_jq) show (1-q_n)K_n tends to 1, and a controlled Taylor expansion of the product gives e^-1/[ (1-s0) K_n ]; the s0=1 singular boundary is correctly excluded. The standalone finite-horizon Markov recursion checker passed 42,228 supplementary checks, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The emerging field observation of seed persistence through unsuitable matrix raises a precise establishment-versus-recognition question. The all-n closed characterization, monotone response to corridor length, and robust heterogeneous e^-1/K_n relative loss quantify a natural information constraint absent from the empirical mechanism; the fact concerns establishment rather than demographic growth and has a credible use as a dispersal benchmark without needing a field-calibrated downstream theorem.
